abstract: A 45-year-old woman suffered from hypertension and congestive heart failure for 5 months. She was found to have a choriocarcinoma of the left mesosalpinx. The final event was, in all probability, a massive pulmonary tumor embolus which occurred shortly after removal of the uterus and adnexae. The tumor was studied by immunohistochemical methods as well as ultrastructurally, and the findings are illustrated and described.
abstract_ja: 45歳女性が5か月間続く高血圧とうっ血性心不全を呈し、左卵管間膜の絨毛癌と診断された。最終的な出来事は、子宮と付属器の摘出直後に生じたと考えられる大量の肺腫瘍塞栓であった。腫瘍は免疫組織化学的および超微細構造的に検討され、所見を図示して記載した。
